question: Among our top 10 paying customers, can you identify the largest change in payment amounts from one month to the immediately following month? Specifically, please determine for which customer and during which month this maximum month-over-month difference occurred, and provide the difference rounded to two decimal places.
sql:
WITH top10 AS (
    SELECT customer_id
    FROM (
        SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) as total_paid
        FROM payment
        GROUP BY customer_id
        ORDER BY total_paid DESC
        LIMIT 10
    )
),
monthly_totals AS (
    SELECT p.customer_id,
           date_trunc('month', p.payment_date) as payment_month,
           SUM(p.amount) as monthly_total
    FROM payment p
    WHERE p.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM top10)
    GROUP BY p.customer_id, date_trunc('month', p.payment_date)
),
with_lag AS (
    SELECT customer_id,
           payment_month,
           monthly_total,
           LAG(monthly_total) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY payment_month) as prev_month_total
    FROM monthly_totals
)
SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, w.customer_id,
       w.payment_month,
       ROUND(w.monthly_total - w.prev_month_total, 2) as mom_difference
FROM with_lag w
JOIN customer c ON w.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE w.prev_month_total IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ABS(mom_difference) DESC
LIMIT 1;
